stem:
The masses of cereal boxes filled by a certain machine have mean 510 grams. An adjustment is made to the machine and an inspector wishes to test whether the mean mass of cereal boxes filled by the machine has decreased.

After the adjustment is made, he chooses a random sample of 120 cereal boxes. The mean mass of these boxes is found to be 508 grams.

Assume that the standard deviation of the masses is 10 grams.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Test at the 2.5% significance level whether the mean mass of cereal boxes filled by the machine has decreased.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Later the inspector carries out a similar test at the 2.5% significance level, using the same hypotheses and another 120 randomly chosen cereal boxes.
parts.text: Given that the mean mass is now actually 506 grams, find the probability of a Type II error.
